summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I did to prepare this plan Before writing this, I read (read-only, no edits) the full chain end-to-end: - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` — loads via `GET /watchlist`, saves via `POST/DELETE /watchlist/:id` and `/watchlist/:id/items` - `client/src/lib/api.ts` — every request sends `credentials: "include"`; no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist code path - `client/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx` + `App.tsx` — session is resolved via `GET /auth/me` before any page (including watchlist) render
